title: 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour
metaDescription: Uncover Turkish history and charm in 5 days. Visit Istanbul’s highlights, explore Bursa’s old town, and marvel at Dolmabahçe Palace with expert guides.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Turkey Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Small Group
summary:
The 5-Day Istanbul, Bursa & Dolmabahce Tour explores Ottoman history on both sides of the Sea of Marmara while leaving time for Istanbul’s earlier Byzantine heritage. Visit Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and Basilica Cistern, step inside the 19th-century Dolmabahce Palace, and see the city from the Bosphorus. The journey then continues to Bursa, the first major capital of the Ottoman Empire, for its historic mosques, Silk Market and the slopes of Uludağ Mountain.
You can choose dates that fit your Istanbul stay. Selected 4-star accommodation with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, airport transfers, the Bosphorus cruise, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are arranged for you.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise and Dolmabahce Palace
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the historic Spice Bazaar and enjoy a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus. Continue across the Bosphorus Bridge to Camlıca Hill for panoramic city views, followed by a visit to the magnificent Dolmabahce Palace. Return to hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bursa Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Bursa. Visit the historic Green Mosque and Green Tomb, followed by the famous Grand Mosque of Bursa. Enjoy a scenic cable car ride on Uludağ with panoramic mountain views before returning to Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour combines Turkey's largest city with its first Ottoman capital. You will visit Istanbul's iconic landmarks, including Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, Beylerbeyi Palace, and the Bosphorus, before traveling to Bursa to explore its historic mosques, markets, and Ottoman heritage. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €795 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, airport transfers, and transportation between Istanbul and Bursa. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the Bursa excursion?
faqs.a: Bursa is famous for its Ottoman history and cultural heritage. Highlights often include the Grand Mosque (Ulu Cami), Green Mosque, Green Tomb, Silk Market, historic bazaars, and panoramic views of the city. Bursa offers visitors a fascinating glimpse into the early days of the Ottoman Empire.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 4 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors. It combines Istanbul's world-famous landmarks with Bursa's rich Ottoman heritage, providing a deeper understanding of Turkey's history, culture, and architecture.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, museums, palaces, bazaars, and mosque complexes. Most sightseeing involves moderate walking and is suitable for travelers in average health.

faqs.q: What is included in the Bosphorus Cruise?
faqs.a: The Bosphorus Cruise offers spectacular views of Istanbul's skyline, waterfront mansions, Ottoman palaces, historic fortresses, and the famous bridges connecting Europe and Asia. It is one of the most memorable experiences included in the itinerary.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 5-Day Istanbul & Bursa Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
